searchResults.highlight:
Since 2010, Diggecard has been working with large brand names in retail and leisure providing gift card expertise and technology, and helping clients to define, launch and grow their gift card programme.
...
Our services are flexible, and our technology is agnostic, enabling clients to connect the right parts together to suit their business objectives and budget. Clients have been able to launch a full gift card programme, or pick the services they need including; online and instore processing, payment and redemption solutions; gift card delivery to consumers and businesses; B2B sales and marketing and sales analysis and reporting.
...
More recently, we have expanded our reach by working with platform partners where our gift card solutions are integrated into a wide variety of platforms, allowing merchants of all sizes to access our gift card technology on a global scale. Platform partners include; payment platforms & ISOs; banks & acquirers; fintechs & ISVs; POS providers; e-commerce providers; hospitality & tourism platforms.
